title: Immutable skill packages over the shared journal

claims.text: package validates 1..256 file objects with unique relative paths, requires SKILL.md at the package root, rejects file/directory collisions, and returns canonical sorted JSON bytes plus their sha256 digest without touching disk.

_payload enforces exact skill.published/skill.retired payload fields, canonical file order, digest agreement with package, and immutable history: republishing a known sha256 with different files raises hash_mismatch.

publish commits the canonical transaction then materializes a confined immutable projection, retire preserves bytes and original receipts while marking the pin retired, and get resolves either an exact pin or the latest active version after verifying the projection.

triggers: hash_mismatch skill event digest disagrees with package
active skill version does not exist

decision.rule: Change here when skill packaging, canonical ordering, immutable history checks, or projection materialization needs to change.
decision.failure: A skill publishes with non-root SKILL.md, history is rewritten under the same digest, or retirement deletes the package bytes.

questions.q: Where does package enforce the SKILL.md entry point at the root?
Where should I change the canonical file ordering for skill packages?
Where can I debug why republishing a digest raises hash_mismatch?
